description: This file contains shell script functions related to boot configuration management, including validation of boot config files, retrieving partition information, and setting primary boot partitions by manipulating binary data within boot configuration files.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Validates the magic bytes in a boot configuration file to ensure it is a valid bootconfig file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of partitions defined in the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Gets the index of a partition given its name within the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Gets the primary boot flag for a specified partition.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot flag for a specified partition.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot flag between 0 and 1 for a specified partition.
